entities.name: José Benavidez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis Benavidez Jr. is an American professional boxer who challenged for the WBO welterweight title in 2018. He is the brother of two-time WBC super middleweight champion David Benavidez. He also made his acting debut as Felix Chavez in Creed III (2023).
